DigitalOcean is part of 1 of my public repositories, from 2014 to 2015.

What it was for: [Systems and infrastructure](@/projects/systems.md) (1).

Most recently: [apollon](@/work/apollon.md): Your own personal cluster built on top of the cloud.

1 of these projects runs as a live site.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses DigitalOcean: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic.
